verdict.rationale: Greptile is an AI PR reviewer, so merge gating is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never mentions a required status check, a blocking or 'request changes' review, or any mechanism that prevents merging while critical findings are unresolved. The 0–5 merge-safety score, severity-sorted findings and unresolved-comment tracking are informational only. The CI/API-key CLI usage says nothing about failing a build or blocking a merge.
